title: pilosella floribunda subsp. suecica
intro: Pilosella floribunda subsp. suecica, commonly known as the Swedish mouse-ear or Swedish woodmouse-ear, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella floribunda subsp. suecica are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
